opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to a $99 membership and expressly connects referral activity with commissions: “In BitLab Network, we pay commissions to refer new members you can receive a payment to join new member.” It then solicits paid mining-pool participation, displaying $500 and $2,000 shares while describing daily commissions from mining profits. The spoken offer goes further, stating that buying a $500 pool position means “you will earn 50% profit,” with part of the proceeds used for new equipment. The invitation to contact the presenter or the person who invited the viewer reinforces a direct audience solicitation. The evidence establishes the promotion of paid membership, referrals, and mining-pool returns, but does not establish completed payments, actual returns, or the full contractual terms.
